RACE-SAFE: ui_sleep_veil_rendered (veil, call_deferred) and ui_toast_rendered (message_layer's async toast drain) are TWO independent async streams whose relative emission order is NOT guaranteed -- it depends on whether the toast queue was empty when the class toast was enqueued (a wall-clock condition). When the prior 'Autosaved' toast is still mid-hold the veil emit lands first (the old local behavior); when the queue has drained the class toast renders immediately, before the veil (the slow-CI-runner behavior that stalled this to a 10s timeout). from_start:true scans from index 0 so this wait matches the (unique) class-toast render regardless of where the veil wait above left the cursor -- immune to either order. Paired with message_layer's headless frame-bounded drain (QA_TOAST_HOLD_HEADLESS_SECONDS).

We found the site off an old expedition ledger — half the pages are about what they didn't bring out. It's in my tent, filed with the survey maps.

steps.name: confirm
steps._comment: Row 0 = "Let's open it up." EMISSION ORDER TRAP: an end:true option tears the graph down BEFORE its effects resolve, so dialogue_ended has to be waited on first or the since-cursor lands past the banks.
To the pedestal court: row 2 east to the x19 column, down it to the y8 lane, then west onto the guardian. The court's own props plug x14-18 on rows 4-6, so the outer lap is the only clean approach.
Bump ruin_guardian (17,8).
Relc fields off the encounter's met_relc ally_requires -- earned back in Act I.
The rune pair, NEAR (16,6) then FAR (15,4) -- the shipped order. Round the plinth on the west side: (18,7) -> (15,7) -> (15,5) -> (17,5).
Bump the plinth (17,6).

steps.name: interact
steps._comment: The re-skinned locked variant: unsealed + joined puts the Horns in the toast, and it still banks nothing -- everything the plinth has to give lands on the open itself.

payload_contains.text: The seal is broken and the Horns are already down the gap — Yvlon bracing, Ksmvr counting rope. The warding still holds the stone fast. Two spiral plates flank the court; Ceria points at the carving beside the pedestal and says that one's a beginning.

steps._comment: Bump rune_plate_near (16,6).
Bump rune_plate_far (15,4). Its bank rides a variant gated on the near plate, so this order is load-bearing.
Bump the plinth again -- all three contains_when counters are live now, so the interact routes to the CONTAINER.

payload_contains.text: Below the pedestal: not treasure. A door, unhung, unmarked, utterly ordinary except that four adventurers go silent around it at once. Ceria, finally: 'That's wardwork. Old, fed wardwork. We're taking it home.' The anchor stone comes up with it.

Below the pedestal: not treasure. A door, unhung, unmarked, utterly ordinary except that four adventurers go silent around it at once. Ceria, finally: 'That's wardwork. Old, fed wardwork. We're taking it home.' The anchor stone comes up with it.

steps._comment: Haul home: the y2 lane back west to the ruin's own exit.
Bump ruin_exit (2,1).
Pisces has the door up against the pantry frame at (13,5).
Bump Pisces.

steps.name: interact
steps._comment: pisces_mounting carries no talk_pool, so door_mounting opens on the first interact.

payload_contains.speaker: Pisces
payload_contains.text: Mounted and hinged. Observe — already holding a hop to Liscor's gate district, and nobody has offered it so much as a rune of encouragement. It works. The next test is range.

steps.name: confirm
steps._comment: Row 0 = 'How far can it actually go?' -- the branch that also renders the far-attunement setup.

payload_contains.speaker: Pisces
payload_contains.text: Farther than Liscor. The wardwork is straining for distance; set a palm to the frame and you can feel the pull. But push it unattuned and things we did not invite will leak through. So we attune it properly. Krshia stocks the catalysts, and I have already started on the calculations for our half of the work.

steps.name: confirm
steps._comment: 'Then let's start.' banks door_mounted, completes horns_dig, and AUTO-STARTS door_that_goes_elsewhere -- the reshaped chain has no start option anywhere.

Pisces's window closed on the counter he just banked, so (13,5) is walkable. Bump east into the pantry door: portal_menu_when opens at door_mounted, so the picker replaces the flavor toast from here on.

steps.name: confirm
steps._comment: From the inn the attuned list is [Liscor - the Gate District, Let it be]: the inn's own row is excluded as the current map and the three far rows still gate on their own attunement counters.

payload_contains.text: Cold light, gone as fast as it came. The gate district's noise rushes back in around you.

steps._comment: GOLD/PACING: the catalyst is 18g and the run holds 34. Detour to the gatehouse FIRST -- Zevara's standing Watch bounties have three unclaimed rows sitting on work this run already did (crate, cisterns, warren), worth 17g together, and her hub only opens them once chatted_with_zevara reaches 2, which this waking's pool line supplies.
Bump Zevara (2,6).

steps.name: interact
steps._comment: First interact with Zevara this waking: pool line, and it takes chatted_with_zevara 1 -> 2.
Visible hub: 0 'Long shift?', 1 'Just getting my bearings.', 2 oldblood, 3 oath, 4 'You pay for jobs?'. The three quest rows are all hide_when-retired now.

payload_contains.speaker: Zevara
payload_contains.text: Good. The Watch posts standing bounties on anything that made a file cross my desk. You clear it and claim it here. I sign it. Keep the receipts honest. The Council audits the ledger every month.

steps.name: confirm
steps._comment: Claim 1/3: the Market Street scavengers (+3). Each claim hide_whens its own row, so the next claim is always visible row 0.

payload_contains.speaker: Zevara
payload_contains.text: Signed. Mind the ink, it's still wet.

steps.name: confirm
steps._comment: 'Anything else on the books?' -> back to the bounty list.

payload_contains.speaker: Zevara
payload_contains.text: Good. The Watch posts standing bounties on anything that made a file cross my desk. You clear it and claim it here. I sign it. Keep the receipts honest. The Council audits the ledger every month.

steps.name: confirm
steps._comment: Claim 2/3: the cistern nest (+4).

payload_contains.speaker: Zevara

payload_contains.text: Good. The Watch posts standing bounties on anything that made a file cross my desk. You clear it and claim it here. I sign it. Keep the receipts honest. The Council audits the ledger every month.

steps.name: confirm
steps._comment: Claim 3/3: the Awakened Raskghar (+10).

payload_contains.speaker: Zevara
payload_contains.text: Signed. Mind the ink, it's still wet.

steps._comment: GOLD/PACING: 34 -> 51 in one gatehouse stop. This is the segment's single largest earning detour and it cost about twenty walked cells; the Watch bounty ledger is where a player who did Acts II-III already has their Act IV budget waiting.
Krshia's stall (13,2), up the y3 lane.
Bump Krshia.

steps.name: interact
steps._comment: First interact with Krshia this waking: pool line (chatted_with_krshia 2 -> 3).

steps.name: confirm
steps._comment: Hub visible row 0 = "What's on the stall today?" -- the crate rows are all hide_when-retired and the friend's-price rows need chatted_with_krshia 4, so they are DROPPED.

payload_contains.speaker: Krshia
payload_contains.text: Silverfang goods. Best in Liscor, and I will hear no argument on it. Cheapest at the front, the good stock where a browsing hand drifts. Coin on the counter and it is yours. No discounts, no haggling. I remember faces.

steps._comment: Stall rows 0-3 are the plain stock, 4 = 'Show me the charms.' The four friend's-price twins are accomplishment-gated and dropped.

payload_contains.speaker: Krshia
payload_contains.text: The charmed stock costs more because it does more. Wear too much of it at once and it starts to argue with itself, so choose with sense. Coin on the counter, same as the rest.

steps._comment: Charms rows 0-5 are the ordinary charms (all gold-gated, so all VISIBLE, locked or not); 6 is the piece under the far cloth. The Pallass stone is row 8 in the file but is accomplishment-gated on pallass_sponsored and therefore dropped -- it comes back in the Pallass segment.
GOLD/PACING: 51 -> 33 on the catalyst.

payload_contains.speaker: Krshia
payload_contains.text: That one, I do not ask questions about. Silverfang trade brings stranger things than that through Liscor. It came in under the wool two winters back and it has sat under that cloth since. Yours now. Wrap it before you carry it. It hums against tin, yes?

steps._comment: Pisces keeps the Guild steps at (30,4). Drop to the y4 lane -- the y3 lane is plugged by an Antinium worker at (24,3).
Bump Pisces.

steps.name: interact
steps._comment: First interact with Pisces this waking: pool line (chatted_with_pisces 1 -> 2).

Visible hub: 0 'Walk me through it again.', 1 'Never mind.', 2 the pantry-door consult, 3 the catalyst hand-over, 4 the sealed wardwork, 5 the other art, 6 the Horns question. Rows needing chatted_with_pisces 3 are still dropped at 2.

payload_contains.speaker: Pisces
payload_contains.text: A door that changes its mind about where it goes. How very like this city — even the fixtures have moods. You could bleed for my curiosity, if that is your instrument. You could attempt to talk me into caring, which has been done, rarely. Or prove you can read a ward without my help, and I will be forced to take you seriously. Choose, and do not waste my morning.

steps._comment: Row 1 = 'Come look at it yourself.' The TALK fork: no cellar fight, no [Observe] the build may not own.

payload_contains.speaker: Pisces
payload_contains.text: You want me to walk into someone's pantry and grope at a wild ward with my bare senses. No. I have wards of my own I would rather keep.

payload_contains.speaker: Pisces
payload_contains.text: A glance. Hm. If it truly reads as spatial and not necrotic, I could examine it without touching a thing. Fine — for the intellectual insult of not knowing. Do not mistake this for a favor.

steps._comment: Row 0 is the [Charming Smile] leg (skill gate -> rendered LOCKED, not dropped, so it still occupies a row); row 2 is the paid leg.

door_that_goes_elsewhere's beats complete IN ORDER: bought_catalyst banked at Krshia emitted NOTHING because the consult beat ahead of it was still open. Buying the catalyst early is legal but silent -- the buy beat only closes here, when door_understood unblocks it, and the engine emits the LAST completed index only.

GOLD/PACING: 33 -> 28. The consult's talk fork costs 5g without [Charming Smile]; the free alternative is the cellar leak fight at the inn, which this run passes over to keep the segment's fight count at spec.

payload_contains.speaker: Pisces
payload_contains.text: A spatial anchor. Crude. Fascinating. Whoever built your inn, adventurer, built it on something that remembers being elsewhere.

steps.name: interact
steps._comment: SAME WAKING: his pool line is spent, so this single interact reopens the graph at the hub.
The consult row is hide_when-retired by door_understood and the recap row by recovered_anchor_stone, so row 2 is now 'I have the stone and Krshia's catalyst.'

payload_contains.speaker: Pisces
payload_contains.text: Then the scholarship is done and the tedium begins. Keep both near the door, and rest. Rest is the instruction; I am aware of how it sounds. Attunement is a residency — the frame learns the stone the way a house learns its family: overnight, and more than once. Sleep. Let the inn do the part no [Mage] can rush.

steps._comment: Home by the Door: the street's own anchor stone stands at (30,10), one east of the arrival cell.

steps.name: confirm
steps._comment: From the street the list is [The Wandering Inn, Let it be].
Up to bed. The y8 lane is the only clear west run now: rift_vermin_leak stands on (9,7) from the mounting onward, and yvlon_inn_returned holds (2,3).

steps.name: interact
steps._comment: Sleep 1/3 -- a silent study beat. sleep_beat.gd:160 counts door_study_sleeps only while door_understood + recovered_anchor_stone + bought_catalyst all hold.

payload_contains.text: Your own bed.

steps.name: interact
steps._comment: Sleep 2/3 -- still silent.

payload_contains.text: Your own bed.

steps.name: interact
steps._comment: Sleep 3/3 -- the awakening.

payload_contains.text: Your own bed.

steps._comment: Fires synchronously inside this sleep(), strictly BEFORE the veil's deferred coverage event -- waited on first for since-marker ordering.
8th waking. The spine quest does not auto-start: pisces_magic's door_awakened row is its only producer, so walk back to the Guild steps and report the awakening.

steps.name: confirm
steps._comment: The list grew a Riverfarm row on the awakening, but Liscor is still row 0.

steps.name: interact
steps._comment: NEW WAKING: pool line first (chatted_with_pisces 2 -> 3).

Visible hub at chatted_with_pisces 3: 0 'Walk me through it again.', 1 'Never mind.', 2 the swordsman row (newly ungated by the third chat), 3 the sealed wardwork, 4 the other art, 5 'The Door woke.', 6 the Horns question. Take the wardwork row FIRST -- it banks heard_pisces_second_door, Act V's own gate on the dungeon attunement sleeps, and it is earned here rather than at the descent ask.

payload_contains.speaker: Pisces
payload_contains.text: The same hand, then, on both sides of the city. Two workings, one wardwright, and no version of that I can make boring. I should very much like to read that wardwork myself — after you have slept. My notes on our frame want reorganizing before I stand in front of its sibling.

steps.name: confirm
steps._comment: 'Back to the top.' -> the hub, one row shorter.
The wardwork row is spent, so 'The Door woke. It reaches past Liscor now.' has moved up to row 4.

payload_contains.speaker: Pisces
payload_contains.text: The Door will show you how far it wants to go. And somewhere under this city is wardwork by the same hand, still fed, still waiting. I intend to understand both. Go — see where it reaches.

steps._comment: Back to the inn by the street anchor stone; the Riverfarm hop is taken from the pantry frame itself.
== ACT IV: RIVERFARM ==. The Door's first far reach. Everything from here is portal travel the run has attuned for itself.
Bump the pantry door.

From the inn the list is [Liscor - the Gate District, Riverfarm, Let it be]. Riverfarm is row 1: portals.json order, current map excluded, unattuned rows omitted entirely (the picker never renders a locked destination).

payload_contains.text: The light warms and the air smells of wheat and river water before you've taken a step. Riverfarm, same as the rumor said.

steps._comment: The longhouse footprint plugs (10,7)-(13,7), so the headman at (11,9) is reached down the x14 column and back along y8.
Bump the headman.

steps.name: confirm
steps._comment: Row 0 = 'Tell me about the blight.' Every other quest row on his hub is accomplishment-gated and dropped at a first meeting.
The longhouse door is the cell directly north.
Bump longhouse_exit (5,6).
The shepherd holds the lamb pen end of the square at (13,10).
Bump the shepherd.
Visible hub: 0 'Just passing through.', 1 'The wolves. Say what you need.' The night-watch row and all three report rows require heard_winter_teeth and are dropped until the offer is taken.

payload_contains.speaker: A Shepherd
payload_contains.text: Stand the watch with me and we thin them. Or the hurdles are cut for a new fold. That's the two I've got. Wolves don't move ground for nothing.

steps._comment: ROUTE NOTE: a_winter_of_teeth's FIGHT leg (river_wolf_pack, (2,14)) is encounter_when phase:night, and phase() is derived from actions_since_sleep against moods.json's 900-action night threshold -- a portal route cannot schedule that. The TRACK leg is walkable and is the quest's own strongest resolution rung, so the run walks the sign back instead.
Bump wolf_sign_trail (4,13).

payload_contains.text: You walk the sign back. The pack came off the north ground by the old line — something denned in it and they gave way. They didn't choose these fields. They were pushed.

steps._comment: West along the y12 lane to the hollow path. (4,11) is the scarecrow and (2,8) the fence line, so y12 is the only clear run.
Bump riverfarm_hollow_path (1,11).
The hollow's y11 lane west, then up the x5 column to the cell below Eloise (5,8).
Bump Eloise.

steps.name: confirm
steps._comment: Row 0 = "What's this blight really about?"; row 1 is the [Calming Touch] mediation. The run HAS that skill now, unplanned: the [Diplomat] class formed during the attunement sleeps off what_the_seal_kept's own resolution grant (persuaded_someone 3 / befriended_moments 5, paid for TALKING Ksmvr through the plates), and diplomat level 1 grants charming_smile + calming_touch. The talk route through the halls bought the talk route through the hollow.

payload_contains.speaker: Eloise
payload_contains.text: There's no blight. Someone in that village struck a bargain with me — asked a favor, got exactly what they asked for. The price was always the second half of the deal, and they're pretending they forgot that part. The craft has been collecting on the debt ever since, out of their fields.

steps.name: confirm
steps._comment: 'Back to it.' -> the hub, so the mediation can be taken in the same sitting.
Row 1 = "Let's not make this ugly. I'll broker fair terms. [Calming Touch]".

payload_contains.speaker: Eloise
payload_contains.text: Broker. That's a word for it. Go on, then, make your pitch. I'll hear it out. I've settled for less than I was owed before now.

payload_contains.speaker: Eloise
payload_contains.text: A year, tending my hearth. Wood in winter, the kettle seen to the year round. It falls short of the debt I was owed. It might do.

steps.name: confirm
steps._comment: The brokered terms: no fight, no coin. The deep briars at (4,11) are the FIGHT leg and this build LOSES that fight outright (measured on this seed: PC dead in three rounds, 65 HP against two 45-HP collectors); the standing-stones knot at (8,10) is [Observe]-gated. Mediation was the only survivable producer of blight_lifted, and only because of the Diplomat.

quest_beat_completed fires SYNCHRONOUSLY between the option's own effects (blight_lifted -> beat -> mediated_the_debt), so the beat wait has to sit BETWEEN the two banks or the since-cursor steps past it.

payload_contains.speaker: Eloise
payload_contains.text: Fine. Tea first, and then it's settled. A year's honest work from a village that never meant to keep its favor. The woodpile is behind the house; tell them it starts there.

steps._comment: Bump Eloise again.

steps.name: interact
steps._comment: SAME WAKING: her pool line is spent, so this opens the graph.

The debt is settled, so the mediation row is hide_when-retired and her coin stock has opened: 0 'What's this blight really about?', 1 'What have you got, for coin instead of favors?', 2 the sell picker, 3 'Just tea, then.' The craft-lesson row hides on drove_off_collectors.

payload_contains.speaker: Eloise
payload_contains.text: Coin, then. Fine — not everyone wants to owe me something bigger. Take what you need and go.

steps._comment: Row 4 = the travel-stone. GOLD/PACING: 18g of the run's 28, and the single purchase the whole Invrisil leg gates on.

payload_contains.text: The stone is warm and it keeps turning a little north in your hand. Ask the Door for Invrisil now and it will know what you mean.

steps._comment: GOLD/PACING: 28 -> 10. The Pallass stone (another 18g) is still ahead and Riverfarm has no purse big enough for it; the Invrisil leg has to pay for Pallass.

payload_contains.speaker: Eloise
payload_contains.text: That stone's walked the Invrisil road more times than I have. Keep it in a dry pocket, on the side you don't fall on. Don't lose it before you get there.

steps._comment: Bump hollow_village_path (11,11).
Back to the headman: y12 east, then the x14 column north to the y8 lane.

steps.name: interact
steps._comment: SAME WAKING: graph opens directly.

steps.name: confirm
steps._comment: The offer row is hide_when-retired, so the report is now visible row 0.

payload_contains.speaker: Former Headman
payload_contains.text: Handled. Good. I won't ask how. Whatever you did, thank you. Truly. Now there's hay down and rain coming, so I'd best be at it.

steps._comment: Report the wolves to the shepherd too.
Visible hub: 0 the night-watch offer (still open), 1 'Just passing through.', 2 'Your wolves were pushed.' -- the traced report.

payload_contains.speaker: A Shepherd
payload_contains.text: Pushed. Off their own ground, by the old line. So it was never my fields they wanted. Wolves and me both, working round something neither of us can see.

steps._comment: Last hollow leg: lattice_witch_lore gates on price_of_a_favor_reported AND spine_started, so Eloise's ward lesson could not be taken on either earlier visit. Three village<->hollow round trips is what the gate ordering costs.
GOLD/PACING micro-detour: the field-work board (3,10) pays 2g once per waking. Small, but it is the only earning surface Riverfarm offers a passing adventurer.

payload_contains.text: You take a scrap off its hook and spend the morning behind it. Ditching, mostly. The pay is small coin, counted out the same day.

steps._comment: Bump riverfarm_hollow_path (1,11).
The hollow's y11 lane west, then up the x5 column to the cell below Eloise (5,8).
Bump Eloise.

Row 5 is the capstone: "You've been sniffing at me since I came in. Go on." It sits one row lower than a force-route player would see it -- the craft-lesson row above it ("Could a person learn it?") hide_whens on drove_off_collectors, so the mediated path keeps that row VISIBLE and pushes the capstone down.

payload_contains.speaker: Eloise
payload_contains.text: Your door smells of a feeding ward. I keep one myself — smaller. Sit. If you're going to live over one, you'll learn what it eats.

payload_contains.speaker: Eloise
payload_contains.text: Mine takes milk and a word, every seventh night. Yours was built to hold something that argues back, and a ward like that gets fed on purpose, by someone who meant it to outlast them. Don't starve it in a hurry, child. Left hungry, it will start drawing what it needs from whatever is nearest — the heat off your hearth first, then the sleep of whoever lives over it.

steps._comment: Bump hollow_village_path (11,11).
To the village milestone (12,5) and out.
Bump riverfarm_anchor_stone (12,5).
